title: Battle of Lwów (1695)
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Lwów (1695)", at revision 1370448335, opens: "Battle of Lwów was an armed clash that took place on February 11–12, 1695 during the Polish–Ottoman War (1683–1699)." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q9173218, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1695 battle during the Polish–Ottoman War". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
